description: NITROX PX implements algorithms in hardware in each of several identical processor cores: SHA and MD5 hash/HMAC, 3 DES/AES256 encryption, and ModMul/ModEx/RSA pkcs 1 v15. IPSec, SSL, and WLAN protocols are aslo accelerated. Performance ranges available: 500Mbps to 2.5 Gbps encryption and/or hash; 4K to 17K RSA ops/sec; 6K to 25K DH ops/sec.
version: Nitrox Px Series Die, 1.2 Nitrox Px TLS KDF, 1.85 (Firmware)
